functionalReqs: Count clicks per ad per minute
Return top N most-clicked ads in the last M minutes
Recompute aggregates from raw data when bugs are found
hints: Do you count per event in a database, or batch counts in a stream processor? What about events that arrive late?
Use event time with tumbling windows and watermarks. How do you make processing exactly-once?

Click logs → Kafka (raw) → stream aggregation (Flink) with windows and watermarks, keyed by ad ID → aggregated results to Kafka → OLAP DB; raw events archived for batch recompute (Kappa replay); dedup by click ID; reconciliation batch job; hot-ad keys split.
nonFunctionalReqs: Correct (used for billing): no double counting, handles late events
End-to-end latency of a few minutes
problemStatement:
Design a system that **aggregates ad click events** in near real time so advertisers can see clicks per ad per minute and billing is accurate.

The numbers are used for billing, so they must be correct even with late or duplicate events.

scaleHints.users: Billions of ad impressions per day
scaleHints.storage: Raw events kept for replay; aggregates kept for years

title: Design Ad Click Event Aggregation
